name: SILA – Smart Internal Linking Assistant
author: Mohamed Annajar

sections.description:
SILA – Smart Internal Linking Assistant helps WordPress website owners discover natural internal linking opportunities across posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.

SILA keeps you in complete control. The plugin scans your content, compares title and content relevance, and generates smart internal link suggestions that you can review before choosing which links to insert.

Whether you manage a personal blog, a business website, or a WooCommerce store, SILA helps you build a stronger internal linking strategy while keeping your content natural, relevant, and user-friendly.

Why use SILA?

  • Improve your website’s internal linking structure.
  • Discover relevant linking opportunities automatically.
  • Keep full editorial control over every inserted link.
  • Supports WordPress posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.
  • Lightweight and easy to use.

Features

  • Generate smart internal link suggestions.
  • Relevance scoring based on title and content similarity.
  • Separate title score and content score.
  • Review suggestions before inserting links.
  • Approve or reject suggestions.
  • Insert internal links with one click.
  • Remove previously inserted links.
  • Internal Link Suggestions metabox inside the editor.
  • Detect existing internal links.
  • Supports WordPress posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.
  • Lightweight and fast.
  • Internal Link Health scanner for posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.
  • Identify orphan, weak, and healthy content based on incoming internal links.
  • Scalable batch scanning for larger websites.
  • Find targeted internal linking opportunities for orphan and weak content.
  • Save and refresh target-specific opportunities without leaving Link Health.
  • Review, approve, reject, insert, and remove links directly from Link Health.
  • Smart anchor options drawn from existing source content, favoring less-used phrases.
  • Preview link placement and choose an anchor before inserting from Link Assistant or Link Health.
  • Configurable limit on contextual internal links per source to avoid overlinking.
  • Bulk approve, reject, and insert from the Link Assistant; bulk insert safely checks each source.
  • One-hour undo for the last successful bulk batch; edits that cannot be safely reversed are skipped.
  • Clear preview guidance and an editor shortcut when automatic placement is not possible.
  • Remembers the administrator’s selected content type when returning from insertion.
  • Shows a separate relevance score and insertion-readiness status for reviewed opportunities.
  • Supports controlled revalidation of existing suggestions with visible batch progress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Link Assistant from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Select a content type and generate suggestions.
  5. Review each suggestion, then approve, reject, insert, or remove links as needed.
sections.faq:
Does SILA insert links automatically?

Yes, when you choose to insert a suggestion. SILA first generates internal link suggestions for review. When you click Insert, SILA automatically adds the link to supported WordPress content. Elementor-built source pages currently require manual insertion.

Does SILA modify my content automatically?

No. SILA never changes your content without your action. Links are only inserted when you click Insert Link.

Which content types are supported?

Posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.

Does SILA support Elementor?

SILA may generate suggestions for Elementor-built pages. However, automatic link insertion into an Elementor-built source page is not currently supported. SILA displays a warning, and the link must be added manually in Elementor.

Can I remove inserted links?

Yes. Any link inserted by SILA can be removed from the Inserted Links section.

Why do I sometimes see “No natural anchor text was found”?

This means SILA found a relevant target page but couldn’t safely identify suitable anchor text inside the source content. You can edit the content manually or choose another suggestion.
sections.changelog:
1.4.3

  • Fixed: the product editor did not refresh automatically after a successful insertion in the Internal Link Suggestions box, because fields that WooCommerce and the editor set up while loading were treated as unsaved changes. Change detection now starts after the editor has finished loading and compares field values instead of field counts.
  • The editor now opens a fresh copy of the page after insertion, so browsers cannot restore old field values over the updated product.
  • If you have unsaved changes, the page is not refreshed and your changes are kept. A clear success notice with a Refresh page button explains what to do. When the description has not been edited, the new link is also placed in the open editor, so clicking Update saves both your changes and the link.
  • Typing in the visual description editor is now detected immediately, including just before an insertion.
  • Fixed: inserting or removing a link could strip backslashes from post content, damaging escaped characters in Gutenberg block attributes, file paths and shortcode attributes.
  • Temporary refresh parameters are removed from the address bar after the editor reloads.
  • Retained the WooCommerce product editor protections from 1.4.1 and 1.4.2. Stock, SKU, prices, description and permalink are not changed by suggestion loading or insertion.

1.4.2

  • Restored automatic editor refresh following successful link insertion when no unsaved form changes are detected.
  • Automatically refreshes only SILA suggestions when editor fields may contain unsaved changes, preserving WooCommerce product data.
  • Keeps insertion confirmation visible after safe reloads and during asynchronous suggestion updates.
  • Retained the WooCommerce editor context protections introduced in 1.4.1.

1.4.1

  • Isolated editor suggestion generation from the WooCommerce product edit request to protect the active product’s global editor context.
  • Eliminated unnecessary Elementor document instantiation during read-only scanning and candidate detection.
  • Kept Elementor document API support for explicit insert/remove actions.
  • Prevented automatic editor reloads after insertion, protecting unsaved WooCommerce product fields.
  • Preserved all existing Dashboard, Link Health, Opportunity Finder, scoring and insertion features.

1.4.0

  • Improved topical relevance scoring for new Dashboard and Link Health opportunities.
  • Added checks for usable link placements before saving new actionable suggestions.
  • Separated relevance scores from insertion-readiness indicators (Ready to Insert, Manual Required, Not Checked).
  • Added controlled revalidation of existing suggestions with persistent assessments and visible batch progress.
  • Improved existing-link detection and correction of outdated insertion readiness in Preview.
  • Improved insertion-success feedback and editor suggestion performance safeguards.
  • Updated output escaping and database query handling for WordPress coding-standard checks.
  • Preserved manually approved, inserted and existing internal links and supported insertion safeguards.

1.3.0

  • Added smart anchor choices that favor variety without creating artificial text.
  • Added a placement preview with actual surrounding source content in Link Assistant and Link Health.
  • Added adjustable internal link limits (default 8) under SILA Settings.
  • Unified preview and insertion logic with checks for duplicates, protected content, Elementor and permissions.
  • Added bulk Approve, Reject, and Insert actions with strict per-batch limits.
  • Added a safe one-hour Undo for the last successful bulk action, including inserted links.
  • Preserved the administrator’s content-type and search selection after insertion.
  • Improved preview UX for Elementor, unavailable anchors, loading and error states.
  • Kept existing suggestions, Link Health scanning, manual review and link removal workflows.

1.2.2

  • Fixed WordPress.org release packaging so the Internal Link Health module and assets are included correctly.
  • No feature or workflow changes.

1.2.1

  • Fixed activation on PHP 8.0 and PHP 8.1 by removing PHP 8.2-only trait constants.
  • No feature or workflow changes.

1.2.0

  • Added Internal Link Health with orphan, weak, and healthy content detection.
  • Added scalable batch scanning for posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.
  • Added content type, health, search, and pagination controls to Link Health.
  • Added targeted Find Opportunities for orphan and weak content.
  • Added persistent target-specific opportunities with manual refresh.
  • Added approve, reject, insert, and remove actions directly inside Link Health.
  • Added synchronization when an inserted link is manually changed or removed from the editor.
  • Improved Link Health and Link Assistant UI, status indicators, loading states, and mobile layout.
  • Improved database queries, indexing, temporary data cleanup, security, and performance.

1.1.0

  • Added an optional feedback card to help shape future SILA improvements.
  • Added a dismiss option so users can hide the feedback card from the dashboard.
  • Improved dashboard feedback messaging.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Generate smart internal link suggestions.
  • Manual review workflow.
  • Approve and reject suggestions.
  • User-controlled internal link insertion.
  • Remove previously inserted links.
  • Title, content, and relevance scoring.
  • Supports posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.
  • Editor metabox integration.
  • Existing link detection.
  • Performance, security, and usability improvements.

upgrade_notice.1.4.2: Restores automatic suggestion refresh after insertion while protecting unsaved editor changes. Includes all 1.4.1 WooCommerce editor safeguards.
upgrade_notice.1.4.1: Critical WooCommerce editor safety fix. Suggestions now load asynchronously so scanning cannot interfere with product editing. Existing links and plugin data are preserved.
upgrade_notice.1.4.0: Improves suggestion relevance, insertion-readiness visibility, revalidation progress, editor performance and reliability. Existing links remain intact. Older saved scores may appear as legacy until checked.
upgrade_notice.1.3.0: Adds smart anchor choices, a placement preview, contextual link limits, bulk actions with undo, and clearer empty states. Existing links are not removed by the limit.
upgrade_notice.1.2.2: Release packaging fix to ensure all Internal Link Health files are included in the WordPress.org download.
upgrade_notice.1.2.1: Compatibility hotfix for sites running PHP 8.0 or PHP 8.1.
